scope: All future ours and baseline scientific method experiments; asset preparation (including SH1 GPT2-XL stats/projector initial setup), setup smoke and storage audits excluded from scientific metric requirements. Existing job identity/privacy policies still apply.
user_quote: 그리고 method 관련 실험에선 (sh1이 진행중인 gpt2-xl 초기 구성 실험 등은 제외) wandb에 들어갈 metric을 맞춰야 하니 첨부문을 확인하고 ours나 baseline 실험 돌릴때 해당 지표로 돌리는 것으로 하자.

attachment.evidence_status: User-supplied historical observations; GH did not independently query historical W&B runs.

compatibility.contract: SH1 schema.COMPARISON_SCHEMA capability and strict metric/config allowlists must satisfy SH4 tracking.contract_ready; preserve backward compatibility for old scalar callers. No science frozen until new caller and helper are both bound.

prefixes.current/pre: Own incoming batch evaluated on pre-write state; edits=batch endpoint for comparison; actual state separately pre_state_edits.
prefixes.current/post: Own incoming batch post-write, including milestones; never substitute all-seen summary.
prefixes.all_seen/post: Only actually measured cumulative endpoints, omit other steps.
prefixes.W0_first2000: Cold W0 exact first2000 only; not historical10k/500/current100.
prefixes.w0/current/N: Same-model W0 neighborhood subset of current cohort.
prefixes.w0/all_seen/N: Same-model W0 neighborhood subset of measured all-seen cohort.

portability: Canonical scalar meanings apply across model/baseline/horizon. Do not force a 2k schedule or new evaluations on other approved experiments. Non-2k cold cohort needs explicit validated W0_first<N> registration/schema extension, never mislabel as first2000. Use cumulative actual request occurrences for edits, including partial/variable batches.

fields.success_count: integer preference successes per existing evaluator (ties as defined by evaluator, no metric change)
fields.success_pct: 0..100 NLL preference success, distinct from TF ACC
fields.token_acc_pct: 0..100 desired-target token micro ACC; token denominator not prompt count
fields.strict_acc_pct: 0..100 all desired tokens correct per prompt

targets: R/P desired=new; N desired=true. Preserve true/new labels, evaluator/token/row identity and denominator. Never use N new-target accuracy as desired locality.

axes.performance: Every evaluation payload includes edits; define_metric prefix wildcard step_metric='edits', step_sync=False.
axes.fit: Separate monotonic fit/global_candidate (or equivalently declared axis), batch/candidate preserved; no per-batch reset overlay.
axes.state: pre_state_edits/post_state_edits explicit. W0 cohort x=0; do not treat pre endpoint label as post-write state.

missing: Omit unmeasured fields or explicit typed availability in local report. Never invent zero/interpolate. No new model forward merely to satisfy logging. Already measured W0/pre/current/all-seen must be mapped from raw correctly.

config.source_links: Explicit sanitized source_run_id/parent_run_id/run URL and observation identity when applicable; strict typed whitelist only. model aliases llama3/gptj/qwen/gpt2xl or validated adapter alias; do not mislabel other writers/baselines as memit.

delivery.identity: Create-once immutable run ID/URL/job/source/config/model/schema receipt separate from mutable transport status.
delivery.ack: SDK_ASYNC_NOT_REMOTE_ACK / LOGGING_ACCEPTED is not remote delivery certification.
delivery.readback: Use bounded existing startup/finish readback to check actual identity and logged rows/edits/key-values; incomplete/unavailable is explicit. No recurring monitoring.
delivery.completion: Uploader/SDK finished does not establish scientific completion.

checks: CPU existing B4/B5 raw: both current R100/P200/N1000, only B5 all_seen R500/P1000/N5000
Distinct R/P/N fields, percent/nats/margin/harmonic, missing and zero semantics
W0 cohort identity and N desired=true; evaluated/token numerators and denominators preserved
Fake SDK define_metric axes, immutable identity, strict config/privacy rejection, job IDs including array index0 and signed step
Helper+producer integration including SH4 contract_ready and scalar payload against stored raw; no GPU test submission
immutable: No frozen/running/PENDING archive hotpatch, restart/cancel, historical rename/backfill or derived snapshot creation by this policy. No additional science submission, cap change or recurring monitor. New-source adoption only.
comparisons: Filter model/writer/role/schema and verify cohort, endpoint, seed/runtime/evaluator identity. Historical mismatches descriptive only; no causal equivalence claim. Saved charts/views not mutated.
